fusions.name: Bait Ball
fusions.desc: The shoal closes around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Snapped Weir
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A bolt of water deals 18 damage to it and leaves it [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Circling Wall
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of circling water 6 tiles long for 6 seconds that enemies cannot cross.

fusions.name: Tightening Ring
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once in a blow for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
